name: Sulfathiazole

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in United States and 2 other countries, first in 1970 — for kidney harm, liver harm and serious skin reactions

similar.name: Sulfamethazine
problems: Pulled from the market in Germany, first in 1992

similar.name: Sulfacarbamide

summary: Sulfathiazole was pulled from the market in the United States and two other countries starting in 1970 due to kidney damage (nephrotoxicity), liver harm, and skin issues [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated a high risk score of 94 for the liver and a low risk score of 16 for the heart [M]. Similar drugs have also been removed from the market in Germany, with one pulled in 1992 and another pulled in 1988 for liver damage and blood-related issues [4][5].
